images.name: steps
images.title: AI patient intake, *step by step*
steps: Name, date of birth, reason for the visit and referral, then the visit type the clinic's rules call for.
Send the forms as a link
History, medications, consent and privacy notice. A reminder two days out if they aren't back.
Carrier, member ID, group number and subscriber from a photo. It asks about anything it can't read.
Through the clearinghouse or the insurer's portal, days before the visit.
Dates of birth, subscriber details, signatures, blank answers, and card against result.
Enter it and brief the desk
Forms and card images attached, with a summary of what's complete and what's outstanding.

images.name: authority
images.title: Patient intake, *duty by duty*
rows: Collects the basics and books the visit type and provider the clinic's rules call for.
Sends the link, follows up on a schedule and offers the questions by phone.
Reads the card, runs the check and files a clean active result.
Enters a file that passed all five checks and sends the desk a summary.
Reports what the check returned. Billing has the cost conversation.
Records the answer as written and sends it to a clinician the same day.
Stops the file until a person has sorted it out.

images.name: one-patient
images.title: First call to *first visit*
rows: A new patient calls. It takes the basics and books a new patient visit for Monday at 9:00.
Texts the link to the forms and the insurance card upload.
Card photo arrives. One digit of the member ID is blurred, so it asks the patient.
The eligibility check comes back inactive. It sends the result to the billing lead.
Forms are half done. It sends a reminder and the patient finishes that evening.
The medication list includes a blood thinner, which is on the flag list. The clinician is told.
All five checks pass. It enters the file and attaches the forms.
The front desk gets the summary. The visit starts at 9:00 with nothing to fill in.
